title: El Estado represivo
goal: Read how the region's military governments dressed repression in a legal facade -- states of siege, dedicated intelligence agencies, and clandestine detention centers.

items: Explain what a state of siege suspended and why it was declared.
Explain what this legal facade actually served to do.
Name at least one country's dedicated repression agency.
Describe how clandestine detention centers operated.
Use en virtud de to name a legal or official basis.
